# Hogar de Ancianos Giuseppe Angelucci (Zaragoza Home)

A small non-profit nursing home for thirty-eight elderly residents in Zaragoza, La Libertad, El Salvador. The home is run by Asociación Gente Ayudando Gente, a local charitable association. Founded around 2013, in a building constructed by the Embassy of Taiwan in El Salvador. Officially recognized as serving a vulnerable community.

## What we do
- Provide housing, food, medical care, and companionship to 38 elderly men and women.
- 35 of the 38 residents have been completely abandoned by their families. Only 3 are visited.
- A seven-person team runs the home day to day, led by General Director Carolina García. Cristian is the resident nurse.
- The home is funded entirely by donations, in-kind support, and volunteer hours.

## The water debt (current fundraising goal)
- A few years ago, a meter change and a leak caused the home's water bills to jump from about $9/month to hundreds of dollars a month.
- A debt of approximately $15,000 accumulated.
- After working with a new water utility administration, a new meter is in place and monthly bills are now back to around $20.
- Donors have already paid down about $8,000 of the original debt.
- About $7,000 still remains to be raised so the home can close this chapter.
